name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Ordering for food trucks
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving even when the signal disappears. An ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is an ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, and then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP TO
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection slot fills up, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches what the kitchen can do.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add orders taken at the food truck to the same screen as advance orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what follows and what is ready, with a warning when an order needs starting.

PRINT KITCHEN TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or the local network and the order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING EVEN WHEN THE SIGNAL DISAPPEARS
Switch on protection for working offline: if the connection breaks, ordering in advance is paused, so nobody sends an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synced when the connection comes back.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Leave the screen on while you work, get notifications when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
